targets.old_statement: Belted occupants who do strike the wheel, dashboard or windshield usually hit with far less force and suffer less serious injury.

targets.old_statement: Adults and children wear belts by the same principle on different landmarks: an adult lap belt sits low on the pelvis touching the thighs, while a child's lies on the upper thighs and snug around the hips.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Adults and children wear belts by the same principle on different landmarks: an adult lap belt sits low on the pelvis touching the thighs, while a child's lies on the upper thighs and snug around the hips.
targets.statement: Once a child transitions out of a safety seat to vehicle belts, position the lap belt firmly across the upper thighs so it stays low and snug over the hips.
